thread:
deploy-bot: [INCIDENT] High GPU queue growth in eu-west1 — paging oncall
asha_oncall: I'm on it, looking at the dashboard now.
ben_sre: seeing steady queue increase and autoscaler not adding nodes. Thundering-burst around 11:03 UTC.
charu_runtime: Autoscaler logs show scale up requests failing with 403 from cloud API — quota error. Full error: \"QuotaExceeded: Insufficient 'NVIDIA_TESLA' quota in region eu-west1\"
asca: (not a real user, system annotation) react :rotating_light:
mike_prodeng: any customer impact yet?
eva_cs: support queue has two customers reporting increased latency and 429s for long-gen jobs. Severity backed to P1 by CS.
asha_oncall: root message — impacted endpoints: /v1/generate and batch inference. Canary routes show degraded latency + large tail. We'll follow standard pager flow.
ben_sre: investigating current capacity: node-pool 'gpu-eu-west1-a' is at max size 6/6. Attempted to scale to 9 but cloud returned quota error for GPUs.
charu_runtime: Confirmed: GPU quota for our project in eu-west1 is 8 gpus total; one of those reserved by another internal project. Autoscaler tried to request 3 new GPUs and hit region limit.
mike_prodeng: Can we failover traffic to eu-central? What are cross-region costs/latency tradeoffs?
charu_runtime: Fallback plan exists — routing policy to prefer eu-central1 when eu-west1 failing. We can flip for non-SLA customers quickly. For SLA customers must ask permission.
eva_cs: We should stage customers: mark customer IDs A-B as high-priority and keep them on eu-west1 if possible.
asha_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) Request quota increase from cloud (slow), 2) Move workloads to eu-central1 for lower priority customers, 3) Temporarily throttle low-priority jobs, 4) Move reserved GPUs from staging (if available).
ben_sre: Quick wins: enable aggressive queue throttling for background/batch jobs and bump routing weights to eu-central for new requests. I can deploy a throttle rule now.
charu_runtime: Before flipping region, we need to ensure eu-central models are warmed and KV caches primed. Cold start could add latency. I'll validate cache priming script.
asha_oncall: Mike — coordinate product decision on who to failover. Ben, can you apply throttling and open a hotfix patch to voting rules?
mike_prodeng: Ok do throttling for non-SLA immediately. Notify CS which customers will be degraded. I'll sign off on region failover for test traffic.
ben_sre: Deploying throttle rule:
```
# ingress policy patch
- route: /v1/generate
  match: header(x-customer-tier) != \"premium\"
  action: rate_limit 15rps
```
Deploying now.
ben_sre: throttle rule applied :white_check_mark: seeing queue slope flatten for low-priority jobs.
eva_cs: Notifying affected customers now. Template: \"We're investigating increased latencies in eu-west1; non-premium jobs may be throttled or shifted temporarily.\"
charu_runtime: Started warmup in eu-central for the most-used model shards. Running warmup script: `kubectl exec -n inference warmup -- /scripts/prime_caches.sh`
charu_runtime: Warmup logs show tokens primed for 3 hot models. Memory/KV usage stable.
asha_oncall: Autoscaler still failing to request GPUs due to quota. I've opened a support case with cloud console and created emergency quota request, ticket #CLOUD-4472. ETA unknown.
ben_sre: As a temporary manual mitigation I can spin up a dedicated node in eu-west1 under a different project that has spare quota (we have sandbox project with 10 spare gpus), but that'll break billing isolation and needs approval.
mike_prodeng: Approve temporary use of sandbox for emergency capacity. Track all costs and move back ASAP. Inform security.
asha_oncall: Ben, proceed with the sandbox spin-up and attach a label `incident=1923456789`. Keep it ephemeral.
ben_sre: Spinning up node pool in sandbox project... `gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=2 --zone=europe-west1-b`
ben_sre: Sandbox nodes up and joined cluster via VPN/proxy, node labels applied. Kube sees 2 extra GPUs now, autoscaler backlog drained ~40% within 5m.
charu_runtime: Routing weights updated: premium customers continue to prefer eu-west1. Non-premium new requests get routed to eu-central1.
eva_cs: Customers updated: Premium customers impacted: none; non-premium: reduced throughput, possible longer response times.
asha_oncall: Monitoring: queue length stabilized and now slowly decreasing. Keep throttles for 30m and re-evaluate.
ben_sre: Still need formal quota uplift for eu-west1 long term. I'll escalate quota ticket and add request for 20 gpus. CLOUD-4472 updated with logs.
mike_prodeng: Action items: 1) Ben - follow quota ticket and revert sandbox after incident. 2) Charu - ensure warmup scripts cover additional models. 3) Asha - run RCA template and timeline. 4) Eva - customer comms postmortem.
asha_oncall: I'll run a short post-incident blameless sync at 14:00 UTC. Please add notes to incident doc.
deploy-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by sandbox capacity + throttling. Closing oncall page.
asha_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open for RCA notes and final timeline. :thumbsup:
